method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited session laws (HB 463/AP with its strike-through and underlining recorded in the .formulas.md sidecar, and HB 1000/AP) from the seat of the individual taxpayer, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (part-year residents, nonresidents and years before 2026 answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Georgia Laws 2026, Act 465 (HB 463, as passed House and Senate, signed 2026-05-11, applicable to taxable years from 2026-01-01) and Act 374 (HB 1000, as passed, effective 2026-03-20), from www.legis.ga.gov, retrieved 2026-10-24, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/ga-2026-act-465-hb-463-ap.txt and ga-2026-act-374-hb-1000-ap.txt. The codified O.C.G.A. is not deposited.
